AutoVecCoder-8B trained by this framework achieves state-of-the-art performance on the SSE and AVX subsets of SimdBench and, in some cases, generates implementations surpassing standard -O3 optimizations, effectively overcoming the inherent bottlenecks of traditional automated vectorization.

</details>


### [351] [Predictive Prefetching for Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17989)
*Wuyang Zhang,Shichao Pei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于预测性预取的异步检索增强生成框架，通过检索预测器、上下文监控器和查询生成器三个组件，利用生成过程中的语义前兆提前预测检索时机和内容，在保持答案质量的同时实现最高43.5%的端到端延迟降低和62.4%的首令牌时间改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同步检索导致RAG系统面临严重的延迟问题，而现有的异步检索方法依赖启发式协调且假设解码阶段信息需求稳定，难以应对复杂多领域场景中不断变化的信息需求。

Method: 提出异步检索框架，包含三个核心组件：检索预测器（预测何时触发检索）、上下文监控器（监控生成上下文）、查询生成器（生成检索查询）。通过捕捉生成动态中不确定性达到关键值之前数个token出现的语义前兆，实现预测性预取。

Result: 在多个基准测试上，端到端延迟降低最高43.5%，首令牌时间（TTFT）改善最高62.4%，同时答案质量与同步RAG基线相当。

Conclusion: 该方法通过预测性预取有效解决了同步检索的延迟瓶颈，且不牺牲答案质量，为异步RAG提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves factual grounding in large language models but suffers from substantial latency due to synchronous retrieval. While recent work explores asynchronous retrieval, existing approaches rely on heuristic coordination between retrieval and generation and assume stable information demands during decoding that often break in complex, multi-domain settings. In this paper, we propose an advanced asynchronous retrieval framework that enables predictive prefetching aligned with evolving information needs. The framework explicitly predicts when retrieval should be triggered and what information should be retrieved using three components, a retrieval predictor, a context monitor, and a query generator, by exploiting semantic precursors in generation dynamics that emerge several tokens before uncertainty becomes critical. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate up to 43.5% end-to-end latency reduction and 62.4% improvement in time-to-first-token, while maintaining answer quality comparable to synchronous RAG baselines.

</details>


### [352] [Semantic Reranking at Inference Time for Hard Examples in Rhetorical Role Labeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18007)
*Anas Belfathi,Nicolas Hernandez,Laura Monceaux,Warren Bonnard,Richard Dufour*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RISE是一个无需重新训练的推理时语义重排序框架，通过利用标签语义信息对低置信度预测进行重排序，在八个领域RRL数据集上平均提升困难样本宏F1值9.15个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RRL方法将标签视为离散标识符，忽略了标签名称中蕴含的语义信息；且语言模型在困难样本上预测不可靠，现有方法对不确定性处理不充分。

Method: 提出RISE框架，包含两个核心步骤：(1) 自动识别低置信度预测；(2) 利用对比学习得到的标签表示对模型输出进行语义重排序，无需重新训练或修改原模型。

Result: 在八个领域特定RRL数据集上、使用七种语言模型（包括编码器架构和因果架构），困难样本上平均提升+9.15宏F1值；并提出人工困难度标注，与模型视角的Cohen's kappa=0.40，呈中等一致性。

Conclusion: RISE通过引入标签语义信息进行推理时重排序，能有效提升语言模型在困难样本上的修辞角色标注可靠性，且模型与人类对样本困难程度的判断存在中等程度的一致性。

Abstract: Rhetorical Role Labeling (RRL) assigns a functional role to each sentence in a document and is widely used in legal, medical, and scientific domains. While language models (LMs) achieve strong average performance, they remain unreliable on hard examples, where prediction confidence is low. Existing approaches typically handle uncertainty implicitly and treat labels as discrete identifiers, overlooking the semantic information encoded in label names. We introduce RISE, an inference-time semantic reranking framework that leverages label semantics to refine predictions on hard instances. RISE automatically identifies low-confidence predictions and reranks model outputs using contrastively learned label representations, without retraining or modifying the underlying model. Experiments on eight domain-specific RRL datasets with seven LMs, including encoder-based and causal architectures, show an average gain of +9.15 macro-F1 points on hard examples. For explainability, we further propose manual hardness annotations to study difficulty from both model and human perspectives, revealing a moderate agreement with Cohen's kappa = 0.40.

</details>


### [353] [PROTEA: Offline Evaluation and Iterative Refinement for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18032)
*Kazuki Kawamura,Satoshi Waki,Kei Tateno*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PROTEA是一个用于多智能体LLM工作流的统一调试与改进界面，通过基于配置评分标准的中间节点评估、后向推理定位瓶颈、以及可编辑的提示语前后对比与自动重评估，在两项生产级任务中显著提升了性能，并在用户研究中获得积极反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM工作流虽优于单提示基线，但调试和优化非常困难——中间输出的细微错误会传播到下游节点，开发者需要检查冗长的追踪日志并推断应修改哪个智能体。

Method: PROTEA提供统一离线测试驱动改进接口：1) 执行工作流并用可配置评分标准对中间节点输出打分；2) 在工作流图上叠加各节点状态与推理说明以定位瓶颈；3) 支持后向节点评估，从最终答案参考和图上下文生成候选节点级期望并与实际输出对比；4) 对选定节点展示可编辑的提示词前后对比，自动重运行并展示输出变化与分数轨迹。

Result: 文档检查准确率从64.3%提升至83.9%，推荐Hit@5从0.30提升至0.38。用户研究中，六位有经验的LLM开发者对图级定位、每节点推理说明和可编辑的提示词前后对比功能给予了积极评价。

Conclusion: PROTEA通过图级瓶颈定位、后向评估和迭代式提示词编辑，有效提升了多智能体LLM工作流的可调试性和性能改进效率。

Abstract: Multi-agent LLM workflows -- systems composed of multiple role-specific LLM calls -- often outperform single-prompt baselines, but they remain difficult to debug and refine. Failures can originate from subtle errors in intermediate outputs that propagate to downstream nodes, requiring developers to inspect long traces and infer which agent to modify. We present PROTEA, a unified interface for offline, test-driven improvement of multi-agent workflows. PROTEA executes a workflow, scores intermediate node outputs with configurable rubrics, and overlays per-node states and rationales on the workflow graph to localize likely bottlenecks. To support complex systems where final-answer references are the primary supervision, PROTEA performs backward node evaluation: it generates candidate node-level expectations from final-answer references and graph context, then compares them with observed node outputs. For selected nodes, PROTEA presents targeted prompt revisions as editable before/after comparisons, then automatically reruns and re-evaluates the workflow to show output changes and score trajectories within the same interface. In two production-adjacent workflows, PROTEA improved document-inspection accuracy from 64.3% to 83.9% and recommendation Hit@5 from 0.30 to 0.38. In a formative study with six experienced LLM developers, participants valued graph-level localization, per-node rationales, and editable before/after prompt revisions.

</details>


### [354] [KVDrive: A Holistic Multi-Tier KV Cache Management System for Long-Context LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18071)
*Jian Lin,Jiazhi Mi,Zicong Hong,Haodong Wang,Qianli Liu,Haodyue Zhang,Peng Li,Song Guo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: KVDrive 是一个面向长上下文 LLM 推理的多层级 KV 缓存管理系统，通过跨 GPU 内存、主机 DRAM 和 SSD 的联合缓存放置、流水线调度和层级协调，在有限 GPU 预算下实现高吞吐推理，相比现有方案吞吐量提升最高达 1.74 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 KV 缓存卸载系统通过选择性获取关键条目来支持长上下文，但稀疏化程度受限于精度要求，导致上下文长度和批大小增长时 KV 传输量剧增，成为解码延迟的主要瓶颈。

Method: KVDrive 从系统层面联合优化三个方面：1）根据注意力行为自适应管理缓存以最大化重用并减少冗余数据移动；2）重构解码流水线，通过 I/O 与 CPU/GPU 计算的重叠消除异构资源间的停顿；3）协调多层级内存间的数据移动，突破 GPU 和 DRAM 的容量限制。

Result: 在长上下文基准测试和主流 LLM 上，KVDrive 相比现有最优方法实现了最高 1.74 倍吞吐量提升，同时保持推理精度不降低。

Conclusion: KVDrive 从系统视角而非单纯算法改进来解决长上下文 KV 缓存管理问题，证明了跨层级协调是突破现有性能瓶颈的有效途径。

Abstract: Supporting long-context LLMs is challenging due to the substantial memory demands of the key-value (KV) cache. Existing offloading systems store the full cache in host memory and selectively fetch critical entries during decoding, but this strategy quickly hits a ceiling: sparsity cannot be pushed further without degrading accuracy. As a result, when context length and batch size grow, the volume of KV transfers rises sharply and becomes the dominant source of decoding latency. We present KVDrive, a holistic multi-tier KV cache management system spanning GPU memory, host DRAM, and SSD. Unlike prior work that pursues greater sparsity through algorithmic refinements, KVDrive tackles the problem from a systems perspective - jointly orchestrating cache placement, pipeline scheduling, and cross-tier coordination to sustain high-throughput inference under tight GPU budgets. KVDrive advances three fundamental capabilities: it adapts cache management to attention behavior to maximize reuse and minimize redundant data movement; it restructures the decoding pipeline to overlap I/O- and CPU/GPU compute-bound stages, eliminating stalls across heterogeneous resources; and it harmonizes data movement across memory tiers to unlock scalable long-context inference far beyond GPU and DRAM limits. We have implemented a fully functional prototype of KVDrive and evaluated it on long-context benchmarks with popular LLMs. The system achieves up to 1.74x higher throughput compared to state-of-the-art works while preserving accuracy.

</details>


### [355] [A Data-Efficient Path to Multilingual LLMs: Language Expansion via Post-training PARAM$Δ$ Integration into Upcycled MoE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18083)
*Hao Zhou,Tianhao Li,Zhijun Wang,Shuaijie She,Linjuan Wu,Hao-Ran Wei,Baosong Yang,Jiajun Chen,Shujian Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一种名为\method的方法，通过将稠密模型上循环为混合专家（MoE）架构，为不同语言分配不同专家，并移植MoE扩展的参数增量(Δ_post)到CPT增强的基础模型上，解决了多语言扩展中参数冲突与能力稀释的权衡问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将LLM扩展到新语言时，传统的持续预训练和对齐阶段成本高昂；现有的数据无关合并技术存在根本性权衡：缓解参数冲突以保留原有能力会稀释新语言习得，反之亦然。

Method: 1) 将稠密模型上循环为MoE架构，为不同语言分配不同专家；2) 通过移植MoE扩展的参数增量(Δ_post)到CPT增强的基础模型，绕过复杂的对齐阶段。

Result: 该方法在扩展语言上表现优于基线（包括FLOPs或参数量相似的基线），同时有效保留原始能力；且适用于不同模型和后训练增量。

Conclusion: \method通过MoE上循环和参数增量移植，成功解决了多语言扩展中的参数冲突问题，实现了新语言能力增强与原有能力保持的双赢，且具有较好的通用性。

Abstract: Expanding Large Language Models~(LLMs) to new languages is a costly endeavor, demanding extensive Continued Pre-Training~(CPT) and data-intensive alignment. While recent data-free merging techniques attempt to bypass alignment by fusing a multilingual CPT-enhanced model with its instruct counterpart, they are plagued by a critical trade-off: mitigating parameter conflicts to preserve original abilities inevitably dilutes new language acquisition, and vice-versa. To resolve this conflict, we introduce \method, which upcycles a dense model into a Mixture-of-Experts~(MoE) architecture, allocating different experts to different languages. Alignment ability is then transferred by grafting a MoE-expanded parameter delta~($Δ_{\text{post}}$) to the CPT-enhanced base model, bypassing the complex alignment phase. Experiments demonstrate \method's superiority even against baselines with similar FLOPs or number of parameters; it improves performance on expanded languages while effectively preserving original capabilities. We further show our approach is highly applicable across different models and Post-training deltas.

</details>


### [356] [How Loud Rumbles Hit Newsstands: A Data Analysis of Coverage and Spatial Bias in German News about Landslides Around the World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18105)
*Brielen Madureira,Andreas Niekler,Marc Keuschnigg,Mariana Madruga de Brito*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文分析了25年间近6万篇德语报纸中关于全球滑坡的新闻报道（涉及5500个事件），并与各国滑坡易发性数据对比，揭示了媒体对南欧和西欧的过度报道等注意力不平等现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新闻是构建灾害数据库和进行媒体注意力动态研究的重要信息来源，但新闻数据集需要经过过滤、地理定位和验证。现有研究缺乏对德语媒体如何报道全球滑坡灾害的系统分析。

Method: 收集25年间近6万篇德语报纸文章，提取约5500个新闻事件，将其与各国滑坡易发性外部指标进行对比分析，考察媒体报道的地理分布特征。

Result: 发现德语媒体对南欧和西欧的滑坡事件存在过度报道，与这些地区实际滑坡易发性不成比例，揭示了媒体注意力在国际灾害报道中的不平等现象。

Conclusion: 研究为关注国际灾害媒体注意力不平等的后续研究提供了基础数据和实证支持，凸显了媒体偏见在灾害报道中的存在。

Abstract: Landslides often hit newsstands due to their destructive and potentially fatal effects. News are a valuable source of information for creating or enriching disaster databases and for expediting media-based studies of the dynamics of media attention. To accomplish that, news datasets must be filtered, geolocated and validated. This paper focuses on how landslides around the world are reported in German newspapers. We analyse almost 60k news articles about 5.5k news events in a 25-year period, compare it with external measures of countries' susceptibility to landslides and provide insights, e.g.~the overreporting of Southern and Western Europe, to foment further studies on inequalities in media attention to international disasters.

</details>


### [357] [How Good LLMs Are at Answering Bangla Medical Visual Questions? Dataset and Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18111)
*Rafid Ahmed,Intesar Tahmid,Mir Sazzat Hossain,Tasnimul Hossain Tomal,Md Fahim,Md Farhad Alam Bhuiyan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个孟加拉语医学视觉问答基准数据集BanglaMedVQA，评估了当前基础模型在该数据集上的表现，发现即使是顶级模型在低资源语言的细粒度医学推理上也存在严重不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管孟加拉语是全球使用最广泛的语言之一，但目前缺乏针对该语言的医学视觉问答(MedVQA)基准数据集。

Method: 构建了BanglaMedVQA数据集，包含经过临床验证的图像-问题-答案三元组，并对当前基础模型在该数据集上进行了全面评估。

Result: 当前模型在孟加拉语MedVQA上的性能显著低于英语；即使是Gemini和GPT-4.1 mini等顶级模型也无法准确回答专业诊断问题；开源模型Gemma-3在通用类别上偶尔超越这些模型，但在临床复杂问题上同样表现不佳。

Conclusion: 低资源语言的医学视觉问答面临严峻挑战，亟需开发更优质的评估方法以推动该领域发展。

Abstract: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) have enabled general-purpose systems to demonstrate promising capabilities in complex reasoning tasks, including those in the medical domain. Medical Visual Question Answering (MedVQA) has particularly benefited from these developments. However, despite Bangla being one of the most widely spoken languages globally, there exists no established MedVQA benchmark for it. To address this gap, we introduce BanglaMedVQA, a dataset comprising clinically validated image-question-answer pairs, along with a comprehensive evaluation of current foundation models on this resource. Consistent with prior findings that report low performance of current models on English MedVQA benchmarks, our analysis reveals that Bangla performance is substantially lower, reflecting the challenges inherent to low-resource languages. Even top-performing models such as Gemini and GPT-4.1 mini fail to accurately answer specialized diagnostic questions, indicating severe limitations in fine-grained medical reasoning. Although certain open-source models, such as Gemma-3, occasionally outperform these models in general categories, they too struggle with clinically complex questions, underscoring the urgent need for top-notch evaluation method.

</details>


### [358] [iPOE: Interpretable Prompt Optimization via Explanations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18113)
*Jiahui Li,Sean Papay,Roman Klinger*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出iPOE，一种通过解释生成可解释性指南来优化提示词的方法，使提示优化过程透明化，在四个数据集上比无指南和随机指南的提示分别提升最高31%和35%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的提示优化方法通常被视为离散搜索问题，其结果难以解释为什么以及在哪里具体的提示变化带来了性能提升。这与人类在标注任务中通过精心设计的标注指南来增强标注一致性的做法形成对比。本文旨在将这两种方法结合起来，使提示优化过程透明化。

Method: iPOE通过自动生成的标注决策解释（来自LLM或人类）来创建指南，并通过一系列操作（删除、添加、打乱、合并）对指南集合进行优化，最终形成包含指南的提示，使LLM的决策过程和优化过程透明化。

Result: 在四个数据集上的实验表明，iPOE相比无指南的提示提升最高31%，相比随机选择指南的提示提升最高35%。此外，LLM生成的解释可以替代人类解释。

Conclusion: iPOE通过引入可解释的指南来优化提示，使得提示优化过程对非专家用户也透明可理解，特别适用于需要专业知识的挑战性领域。

Abstract: Prompt optimization has often been framed as a discrete search problem to find high-performing and robust instructions for an LLM. However, the search result might not make it transparent why and where specific prompt changes lead to performance gains. This is in contrast to how humans are instructed for annotation tasks. Here, researchers carefully design annotation guidelines, leading to enhanced annotation consistency. Our paper aims at joining these two approaches and introduces iPOE, a novel interpretable prompt optimization strategy via explanations. We guide the prompt optimization process by automatically created guidelines from explanations of annotation decisions (either automatically generated or from humans). This set of guidelines is furthermore optimized by as series of operations, including removing, adding, shuffling, and merging. The resulting prompt includes guidelines that instruct the annotation, making the decision process of the LLM and the optimization transparent. It therefore supports also laypeople in the area of prompt optimization, particularly in challenging domains requiring expertise. In our experiments on four datasets, we find that iPOE can improves over prompts without guidelines and with random selected guidelines by up to $31\%$ and $35\%$, respectively. Moreover, LLM explanations can replace human explanations in the proposed method.

</details>

Abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) applications increasingly rely on long conditioning prefixes to control model behavior at inference time. While prefix-augmented inference is effective, it incurs two structural limitations: i) the prefix's influence fades as generation proceeds, and ii) attention computation over the prefix scales linearly with its length. Existing approaches either keep the prefix in attention while compressing it, or internalize it into model parameters through gradient-based training. The former still attends to the prefix at inference, while the latter is training-intensive and ill-suited to prefix updates. To address these issues, we propose attention-state memory, a training-free approach that externalizes the prefix into a lightweight, lookup-based memory of precomputed attention states between prefix and query tokens. Abstract: Recent masked diffusion language models (MDLMs), such as LLaDA and Dream, have achieved performance comparable to autoregressive large language models. Unlike autoregressive models, which generate text sequentially, MDLMs generate text by iteratively denoising masked positions in parallel. During fine-tuning, MDLMs learn to recover responses from masked response states conditioned on a prompt, thereby shifting their predictions from a prompt-masked unconditional distribution toward a prompt-conditional distribution. Despite this distinct generative and fine-tuning mechanism, machine unlearning for MDLMs remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose Masked Diffusion Unlearning (MDU), the first unlearning framework for MDLMs, by revisiting the process of learning specific knowledge in terms of diffusion. Specifically, MDU minimizes a forward KL divergence from the prompt-conditional prediction to a prompt-masked unconditional anchor at every masked response position, with a temperature scaling parameter to control the privacy-utility trade-off. Our empirical results on standard benchmarks and MDLM backbones show that MDU achieves high unlearning performance compared to existing LLM unlearning methods. Code is available at https://github.com/leegeoru/MDU.

</details>

Abstract: Presupposition projection in conditionals is central to theories of meaning and pragmatics, yet it remains largely unevaluated in large language models. We address this gap through a parallel behavioral study comparing human judgments and LLM predictions on a normed dataset of conditional sentences that controls the relation between the antecedent and the projected presupposition. We collect likelihood ratings from 120 participants and four LLMs under matched contextual conditions. Results show that humans integrate probabilistic and pragmatic cues in their judgment, whereas LLMs show variable alignment with human patterns. Using a linguistically motivated checklist within an LLM-as-a-Judge framework, we further evaluate model reasoning. We observe models that best match human ratings often lack coherent pragmatic reasoning, while models with stronger reasoning produce less human-like judgments. These findings suggest that LLMs' performance on such tasks may result from surface pattern matching rather than pragmatic competence. Our findings highlight the importance of benchmarks grounded in linguistic theory for comparing humans and models.

*Angelos Angelopoulos,James F. Cahoon,Ron Alterovitz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种集成大语言模型与实验室编排的AI智能体架构，支持科学家通过自然语言交互式地创建和监控自动化实验流程。该架构集成在实验编排系统(EOS)中，采用智能体循环机制实现自动验证和错误纠正，支持从协议创建、运行监控到结果分析的完整实验生命周期。在化学、生物学和材料科学三个模拟自动化实验室上评估，首次协议生成成功率达97%，所需界面操作减少一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化科学实验室虽能加速新材料的发现与测试，但设置和运行自主实验室需要协调众多仪器和机器人，迫使科学家编写代码、管理配置文件并导航复杂的软件基础设施，门槛极高。现有方案缺乏自然语言交互能力，限制了科学家的使用效率。

Method: 提出AI智能体架构，将LLM与实验室编排系统EOS集成。采用智能体循环(agentic loop)机制，包含自动验证和错误纠正。提供可视化图形编辑器，以交互式节点图形式展示协议，并实现AI辅助与手动构建的无缝切换。

Result: 在三个模拟自动化实验室（化学、生物学、材料科学）上评估，首次协议生成成功率达97%，所需界面操作减少一个数量级。

Conclusion: 该AI智能体架构显著降低了自动化实验的操作门槛，让科学家能通过自然语言高效创建和管理实验协议，有望加速科学发现进程。

Abstract: Automating science laboratories enables faster, safer, more accurate, and more reproducible execution of protocols, accelerating the discovery and testing of new materials, drugs, and more. However, setting up and running autonomous labs requires coordinating numerous instruments and robots, forcing scientists to write code, manage configuration files, and navigate complex software infrastructure. We present an AI agent architecture that integrates large language models with laboratory orchestration, enabling scientists to interactively create and monitor automated lab protocols using natural language. Integrated into the Experiment Orchestration System (EOS), the AI agent operates under an agentic loop with automated validation and error correction, and supports the complete experimental lifecycle: creating protocols, running and monitoring both protocols and closed-loop optimization campaigns, and analyzing results. A visual graph editor renders protocols as interactive node-based diagrams synchronized with the AI agent's protocol representation, enabling seamless alternation between AI-assisted and manual protocol construction. Evaluated on three simulated automated labs spanning chemistry, biology, and materials science, the AI agent achieves a 97% first-attempt protocol generation success rate and an order of magnitude reduction in required interface actions.

</details>


### [390] [Skim: Speculative Execution for Fast and Efficient Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16565)
*Mike Wong,Kevin Hsieh,Suman Nath,Ravi Netravali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Skim是一个投机执行框架，通过离线分析网站结构模式（URL、答案格式、任务轨迹映射），使大多数查询绕过昂贵的大模型推理和浏览器渲染，仅用轻量级模板匹配+小模型+验证器即可完成，将Web Agent的中位任务成本降低1.9倍、延迟降低33.4%且不损失准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前Web Agent的昂贵开销并非任务本身固有，而是由"前沿模型推理+浏览器渲染+ReAct规划"在每个任务步骤上无差别堆叠所致。论文观察到目的性构建的网站具有高度可预测的结构，因此大多数查询实际上不需要这些重型组件。

Method: Skim包含两个阶段：(1) 离线分析器针对每个网站捕获稳定的URL模式、答案格式和任务-轨迹映射；(2) 运行时，将查询匹配到模板，合成目标URL，用小型模型提取答案，再通过轻量验证器检查输出与查询/模式的匹配性。少数误推测会回退到完整Agent，但利用快速路径的最终URL进行热启动以保留上游轨迹进展。

Result: 在WebVoyager、AgentOccam、BrowserUse三个骨干Agent上，Skim将中位每任务成本降低1.9倍，延迟降低33.4%，且无准确率损失。

Conclusion: 利用网站结构可预测性设计的投机执行框架，能够在不牺牲准确率的前提下显著降低Web Agent的成本与延迟，验证了"大多数查询不需要完整推理管线"的核心假设。

Abstract: Skim is a speculative execution framework for web agents that exploits the predictable structure of purpose-built websites. Today's web-agent expense is not intrinsic to the tasks but a property of how agents are composed: frontier-model inference, browser rendering, and ReAct-style planning are applied to every step of every task regardless of complexity. Skim's key observation is that websites enforce stable URL patterns, answer formats, and task-to-trajectory mappings across queries of the same type, so most queries can bypass these heavyweight components entirely. An offline profiler captures these patterns once per site. At runtime, Skim matches each query to a template, synthesizes the destination URL, and extracts the answer with a small model. A lightweight verifier gates each fast-path output against the query and schema; rare misspeculations cascade to the full agent, warm-started by the fast path's final URL to preserve upstream trajectory progress. Across standard web-agent benchmarks paired with three backboneagents (WebVoyager, AgentOccam, BrowserUse), Skim reduces median per-task cost by 1.9x and latency by 33.4% with no accuracy loss.

</details>


### [391] [Scalable Uncertainty Reasoning in Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16568)
*Jingcheng Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本论文提出了一个模块化框架，通过代数、逻辑和几何三种专门推理机制，分别处理知识图谱中属性值不精确、三元组存在概率性、模式知识不完整三个层面的不确定性，在保持语义精度的同时确保计算可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界数据常具有不确定性，而现有语义网标准缺乏对不确定性的原生支持，且简单扩展往往导致计算不可解。

Method: (1) 定义概率文字及连续属性的查询代数；(2) 基于编译的框架，将SPARQL溯源转换为易处理的概率电路；(3) 拓扑感知的几何嵌入用于统计模式推理。

Result: 通过代数、逻辑和几何三种专门机制，分别处理三个层面的不确定性，实现语义精度与计算可处理性的平衡。

Conclusion: 专门化的推理机制（代数、逻辑、几何）能够在保持语义精度的同时实现计算可处理性，为知识图谱中的不确定性推理提供了模块化解决方案。

Abstract: Knowledge Graphs are pivotal for semantic data integration. The real-world data they model is often inherently uncertain. Within knowledge graphs, uncertainty manifests in three distinct levels: imprecise attribute values, probabilistic triple existence, and incomplete schema knowledge. However, current Semantic Web standards lack native support for reasoning over such uncertainty, and naïve extensions often incur computational intractability. In this thesis, I aim to develop a modular framework that addresses each level through tailored techniques: (1) defining probabilistic literals and a corresponding query algebra for continuous attributes; (2) a compilation-based framework transforming SPARQL provenance into tractable probabilistic circuits for uncertain triples; and (3) topology-aware geometric embeddings for statistical schema reasoning. The central hypothesis is that specialized reasoning mechanisms, namely algebraic, logical, and geometric approaches, can reconcile semantic precision with computational tractability.

</details>


### [392] [Counterparty Modeling is Not Strategy: The Limits of LLM Negotiators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16575)
*Romain Cosentino,Sarath Shekkizhar,Adam Earle,Silvio Savarese*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了大语言模型智能体在多属性谈判中的表现，发现它们虽然能准确建模对手偏好，但无法将这种知识转化为战略性议价行为，最终协议更受表面锚定效应而非实际效用权重的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谈判不仅需要推断对方需求，还需要利用这些信息在多个回合中做出有利的报价和还价。作者希望探究当前LLM智能体是否具备这种战略性谈判能力。

Method: 在受控的多属性议价环境中，评估LLM智能体对对手偏好的建模能力、战略性让步行为、信息不对称条件下的表现，以及显式要求智能体提出让步换互惠交易的效果。

Result: LLM智能体能够准确建模对手偏好，但这并未可靠地提升知情方的谈判结果；卖方整体更迁就对方；知情方在信息不对称条件下做出更多弱补偿性让步；智能体未能利用效用结构获取战略优势，最终协议受表面锚定主导；要求显式交易声明虽使单回合更具策略性，但未能提升最终协议效率。

Conclusion: 当前LLM智能体具备偏好建模能力，但缺乏将效用结构信息转化为战略性多轮博弈优势的能力，其行为更受表面锚定和迁就倾向驱动。

Abstract: Negotiation requires more than inferring what the other side wants: it requires using that information to make advantageous offers and counteroffers over multiple turns. We study whether large language model (LLM) agents do this in a controlled multi-attribute bargaining environment. We find that current LLM agents can model a counterparty's preferences, but do not reliably turn that knowledge into strategic bargaining. When given negotiating partner preference information, agents model it accurately and early in their reasoning traces, yet this does not reliably improve outcomes for the informed side. Turn-level analyses show why: agents often respond to what they believe the counterparty values, but do not consistently pair those moves with gains on their own high-value attributes. Sellers are more accommodating overall, and in asymmetric-information conditions, the informed side often makes the more weakly compensated concessions. Because agents fail to leverage this underlying utility structure for strategic advantage, their final agreements are heavily dictated by surface-level opening anchors rather than actual utility weights. Finally, requiring agents to explicitly state concession-for-reciprocity trades before making an offer makes individual turns look more strategic, but ultimately fails to improve the efficiency of the final agreements.

</details>


### [393] [TTE-Flash: Accelerating Reasoning-based Multimodal Representations via Think-Then-Embed Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16638)
*Jianpeng Cheng,Xian Wu,Jiangfan Zhang,Wentao Bao,Chaitanya Ahuja,Shlok Kumar Mishra,Hanchao Yu,Yang Gao,Fan Xia,Qi Guo,Shaodan Zhai,Xiangjun Fan,Jun Xiao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出用潜在思考令牌（latent think tokens）替代显式链式思维（CoT）推理，在恒定推理成本下实现高性能推理感知的多模态嵌入，所提TTE-Flash-2B模型在MMEB-v2基准上超越显式CoT对应方法，且潜在思考令牌可解释、具备自适应预算分配能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态嵌入（UME）从链式思维推理中获益显著，但生成显式CoT轨迹的计算开销过大，亟需一种在保持推理感知能力的同时降低推理成本的方法。

Method: 将显式CoT替换为潜在思考令牌（视为潜变量，显式CoT为观测变量），使用CoT生成损失优化思考令牌，再用对比损失优化嵌入令牌；研究两种架构设计：思考令牌与嵌入令牌如何从同一LLM主干提取，以及如何作为两个依赖任务进行训练。

Result: TTE-Flash-2B在MMEB-v2基准上超越显式CoT对应方法；零样本视频评估显示随思考令牌数量增加呈现扩展行为，并启发了基于任务需求的自适应思考预算分配。

Conclusion: 潜在思考令牌能有效替代显式CoT，在恒定的推理成本下实现更高性能的推理感知多模态表示，且具备良好的可解释性和自适应扩展能力。

Abstract: Recent research has demonstrated that Universal Multimodal Embedding (UME) benefits significantly from Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. In this paradigm, a generative model produces explicit reasoning traces for a multimodal query, with the final representation extracted from an <eos> embedding token attending to both the query and the reasoning. Despite its effectiveness, the computational overhead of generating explicit CoT traces is often prohibitive. In this work, we propose replacing explicit CoT with latent think tokens, which are interpreted as latent variables that can produce explicit CoT traces as observed variables. By optimizing think tokens using CoT generation loss and subsequent embedding tokens using contrastive loss, we produce high-performance, reasoning-aware representations at a constant inference cost. Our study investigates two key architectural designs: 1) how think and embeddings tokens should be extracted from the same LLM backbone. 2) how the tokens should be trained as two dependent tasks. We introduce TTE-Flash-2B, a reasoning-aware multimodal representation model that outperforms its explicit-CoT counterpart on the MMEB-v2 benchmark, while producing latent think tokens that are interpretable both textually and visually. Furthermore, zero-shot evaluation across 15 video datasets reveals scaling behavior as the number of think tokens increases, and motivating a pilot study of adaptive think budget allocation based on task requirements.

</details>


### [394] [LinAlg-Bench: A Forensic Benchmark Revealing Structural Failure Modes in LLM Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16675)
*Shradha Agarwal,Deepak Rajbhar,Tariq J*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LinAlg-Bench是一个用于评估大语言模型线性代数计算能力的诊断性基准，包含660个SymPy验证的问题和9种任务类型。对10个前沿模型在3x3、4x4、5x5矩阵维度梯度上进行评估，发现LLM在4x4维度存在一个尖锐的行为阈值：低于该阈值时模型出现执行错误，高于该阈值时模型转向计算放弃和结构幻觉。研究还揭示了策略刚性与5x5行列式准确率的近乎完美预测关系，并识别了约束感知型虚构这一新型结构化幻觉失败模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试对LLM数学推理能力的评估多停留在二元准确性层面，缺乏对失败模式的系统分类和结构化分析。需要更精细的诊断工具来理解LLM在结构化线性代数计算中的失败机制，特别是失败是否随机分布还是具有结构性规律。

Method: 构建包含660个SymPy认证问题的LinAlg-Bench基准，涵盖9种任务类型和3x3/4x4/5x5矩阵维度梯度。对10个前沿LLM进行6,600次输出评估，引入三阶段自动化取证流水线，将1,156个失败分类为10个主要错误标签及细分子类型。

Result: 发现LLM数学失败具有结构性而非随机性，存在4x4维度的行为阈值；低于4x4时失败为执行错误（符号追踪失败、算术漂移、奇偶错误），高于4x4时转为计算放弃（工具角色扮演、约束一致虚构、结构化幻觉）。识别出三种尺度涌现错误类型，仅在4x4和5x5出现。策略刚性与5x5行列式准确率近乎完美相关。

Conclusion: LLM的数学推理失败模式表现出结构性规律，核心限制可能源于工作记忆容量而非知识缺失。约束感知型虚构是LLM数学推理中的一种新型结构化幻觉失败模式。所有数据、模型输出、错误标签和评判流水线均已公开。

Abstract: We introduce LinAlg-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark evaluating 10 frontier large language models on structured linear algebra computation across a strict dimensional gradient of 3x3, 4x4, and 5x5 matrices. Spanning 9 task types and 660 SymPy-certified problems, the benchmark exhaustively evaluates 6,600 model outputs. Beyond binary accuracy, LinAlg-Bench introduces a three-stage automated forensic pipeline classifying 1,156 failures into ten primary error tags with fine-grained subtypes, revealing that LLM mathematical failure is not random but structurally constrained by algorithm type and matrix dimension. Our central finding is a sharp behavioral threshold at 4x4 scale: below it, models fail through execution errors -- sign tracking failures, arithmetic drift, and parity errors; above it, failure transitions to computational abandonment, with models fabricating responses through tool roleplay, constraint-consistent confabulation, and structured hallucination rather than attempting computation. This fabrication-to-abandonment transition is near-universal across all model tiers and architectures, suggesting a working memory limit rather than a knowledge gap, supported by three scale-emergent error types absent at 3x3 but present at 4x4 and 5x5. We further show that solution strategy rigidity is a near-perfect predictor of 5x5 determinant accuracy, document constraint-aware confabulation as a novel structured hallucination failure mode, and release all data, model outputs, error labels, and judge pipeline publicly.

</details>


### [395] [Recall Isn't Enough: Bounding Commitments in Personalized Language Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16712)
*Rui Tang,Yichi Zhang,Xi Chen,Chen Dong,Youwei Yang,Yumeng Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出契约约束证据激活（CBEA）与词典承诺验证（LCV）方法，通过有界证据集、类型覆盖、尾随证人和后果债务机制，以及结构化承诺验证，在360个测试用例和三个生成后端上实现验证器范围内的零失败，可用性达0.49-0.60，同时将输入载荷降低74-75%。但该方法以牺牲通用记忆能力为代价，仅召回0.012的未编译可见事实。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长上下文和记忆系统将个性化视为简单的召回问题，但在实际应用中常因将噪声线索转化为硬约束、丢弃罕见见证、遗忘下游义务或在不可行条件下回答而导致失败。需要一种更可靠的机制来管理承诺和执行边界。

Method: 提出CBEA（契约约束证据激活）和LCV（词典承诺验证）方法。CBEA使用类型覆盖、尾随证人和后果债务激活有界证据集；LCV在生成文本前验证结构化承诺，将不可行状态路由至修复、弃权或重新契约。

Result: 在360个测试用例和三个生成后端上，CBEA+LCV在验证器范围内达到零失败，可用性为0.49-0.60（对比基线0.003-0.092）。输入载荷中位数降低74-75%，但仅召回0.012的未编译可见事实（基线0.53）。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了一个有界运行点：显式承诺控制和更低的输入载荷，而非追求通用的记忆优势。通过可控的召回牺牲换取可靠性和承诺管理。

Abstract: Long-context and memory systems usually treat personalization as a recall problem. In practice, many failures occur later, when a system commits: it turns noisy hints into hard constraints, drops rare witnesses, forgets downstream obligations, or answers despite infeasibility. We introduce Contract-Bounded Evidence Activation (CBEA) with Lexicographic Commitment Validation (LCV). CBEA activates a bounded evidence set using typed coverage, tail witnesses, and consequence debt; LCV validates structured commitments before prose and routes infeasible states to repair, abstention, or recontract. Across 360 fixtures and three generation backends, CBEA+LCV reaches zero failures within validator scope at 0.49-0.60 availability over attempted runs. Raw and long-context baselines with the same LCV gate reach zero only at 0.003-0.092. A shadow oracle diagnostic marks the limit: CBEA+LCV recalls 0.012 of uncompiled visible facts, while raw recalls 0.53. The result is a bounded operating point: explicit commitment control and 74-75% lower median input payload, not universal memory dominance.

</details>


### [396] [Baba in Wonderland: Online Self-Supervised Dynamics Discovery for Executable World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16725)
*SeungWon Seo,DongHeun Han,SeongRae Noh,HyeongYeop Kang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Alice系统，通过将失败的候选更新作为结构信号，在词汇先验不匹配条件下学习可执行世界模型，在Baba in Wonderland任务上显著提升效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可执行世界模型需要捕获环境的状态转移规律而非表面语义捷径，但在先验不匹配（词汇标签与真实语义无关）的条件下，智能体无法依赖规则描述、奖励信号或可信的词汇先验，只能从交互证据中学习状态依赖的动态。

Method: Alice是一个闭环系统：当候选更新解释新转换但丢失已解释转换时，保留冲突揭示当前程序混淆的动态；将这些冲突精炼为假设类，提供分层保留反例用于更新，并引导前沿探索朝向当前程序未充分覆盖的新转换。

Result: 在Baba in Wonderland（Baba Is You的变体，保留模拟器动态但用无关词汇替换语义规则标签）上的实验表明，Alice显著提升了在先验不匹配条件下的可执行世界模型学习效果；消融实验证明类别精炼和类别感知探索均有效。

Conclusion: Alice通过将失败更新作为结构性信号并利用假设类引导探索，有效解决了可执行世界模型学习中先验不匹配的问题。

Abstract: Executable world models can be read, edited, executed, and reused for planning, but only if the program captures the environment's transition law rather than semantic shortcuts in its surface vocabulary. We study online executable world-model learning under prior misalignment, where an agent must induce state-dependent dynamics from interaction evidence alone, without rule descriptions, reward signals, or trustworthy lexical priors. We introduce Alice, a closed-loop system that treats failed candidate updates as structural signal: when a candidate explains a new transition but loses previously explained ones, the preservation conflict reveals dynamics that the current program had conflated. Alice refines these conflicts into hypothesis classes that both provide compact, class-stratified preservation counterexamples for update and guide frontier exploration toward transitions that are novel and underrepresented with respect to the current program. We evaluate Alice on Baba in Wonderland, a prior-misaligned variant of Baba Is You that preserves simulator dynamics while replacing semantically meaningful rule-property labels with unrelated words. Experiments show that Alice substantially improves executable world-model learning under prior misalignment, and ablations show that both class refinement and class-aware exploration contribute.

</details>


### [397] [State Contamination in Memory-Augmented LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16746)
*Yian Wang,Agam Goyal,Yuen Chen,Hari Sundaram*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现了LLM智能体中的“记忆洗钱”现象：有毒或对抗性上下文被压缩成记忆摘要后，标准检测器无法识别其毒性，但仍能影响后续生成。作者提出亚阈值传播差距（SPG）量化这种隐藏影响，并发现干预时机至关重要——在压缩前净化有毒状态可显著减少隐藏传播，而仅清理已完成摘要效果有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体依赖持久化状态（如转录、摘要、检索上下文、记忆缓冲区）支持长程交互，这使得安全性不仅取决于单次输出，还取决于智能体存储和复用的内容。现有安全检测主要关注模型输出，忽视了记忆中隐藏的有毒信息传播风险。

Method: 使用成对反事实多智能体推演（paired counterfactual multi-agent rollouts），比较有毒来源记忆摘要与匹配的中性基线在下游毒性上的差异。提出亚阈值传播差距（Sub-threshold Propagation Gap, SPG）量化记忆状态中被监测系统判定为安全但实际仍携带隐藏影响的传播程度。

Result: 毒性通过不同的状态通道传播：原始转录重用驱动明显的下游毒性，而压缩记忆携带隐藏的亚阈值影响。在总结前净化有毒状态能显著缩小隐藏传播差距，而仅清理已完成摘要可能留下洗钱后的影响。

Conclusion: 记忆增强型智能体的安全性应被视为一个关于演化上下文的**状态控制问题**，净化措施应在不安全信息被压缩进持久记忆之前应用，而非事后清理。

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent state, including transcripts, summaries, retrieved context, and memory buffers, to support long-horizon interaction. This makes safety depend not only on individual model outputs, but also on what an agent stores and later reuses. We study a failure mode we call memory laundering: toxic or adversarial context can be compressed into memory summaries that no longer appear toxic under standard detectors, while still preserving hostile framing or conflict structure that influences future generations. Using paired counterfactual multi-agent rollouts, we show that toxic-origin memory summaries can remain below common toxicity thresholds while nevertheless increasing downstream toxicity relative to matched neutral baselines. To measure this hidden influence, we introduce the sub-threshold propagation gap (SPG), which quantifies downstream behavioral differences conditioned on memory states that a deployed monitor would classify as safe. Our experiments show that toxicity propagates through distinct state channels: raw transcript reuse drives overt downstream toxicity, while compressed memory carries hidden sub-threshold influence. We further find that mitigation depends critically on intervention placement. Sanitizing toxic state before summarization substantially reduces the hidden propagation gap, whereas cleaning only the completed summary can leave laundered influence intact. These results suggest that safety in memory-augmented agents should be treated as a state-control problem over evolving context, with sanitization applied before unsafe information is compressed into persistent memory.

</details>


### [398] [Multi-Paradigm Agent Interaction in Practice:A Systematic Analysis of Generator-Evaluator, ReAct Loop,and Adversarial Evaluation in the buddyMe Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16821)
*Xiaohua Wang,Chao Han,Kai Yu,XiaoLiang Xu,Liang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统分析了 buddyMe 框架中实现的三种智能体交互范式（多智能体编排、ReAct 工具使用循环、记忆增强交互），通过四组真实案例和六维评估体系，得出三个关键结论：生成器-评估器预审可检测20%复杂任务的需求遗漏、ReAct 循环稳定但存在约30%冗余工具调用、对抗性讨论主要在2-3轮内达成共识并用于内容精炼而非逻辑反转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体产生了多样化的交互范式，但很少有生产系统能在统一架构中集成多种范式，缺乏对不同范式在统一框架下的系统性比较与评估。

Method: 提出五阶段处理流水线（需求预审→任务分解→ReAct执行→真实执行验证→对抗性评估讨论），建立六维加权评分评估体系，并在 buddyMe 开源框架中实现三种交互范式，通过四组真实部署案例进行实证分析。

Result: 生成器-评估器预审在20%的复杂任务中检测到需求遗漏，80%任务通过初始检查；ReAct 循环确保稳定子任务执行但导致约30%冗余工具调用；对抗性评估-辩护讨论在约70%场景中2-3轮内达成共识，主要功能为内容精炼而非逻辑反转。

Conclusion: 研究结果为构建稳定可靠的多范式智能体系统提供了实用设计指南，并通过与 CrewAI、AutoGen 等主流框架的跨范式比较，揭示了不同范式在六维系统指标上的优劣。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) agents has produced diverse interaction paradigms, yet few production systems integrate multiple paradigms within a unified architecture. This paper presents a systematic analysis of three principal agent interaction paradigms, including Multi-Agent Orchestration (Generator-Evaluator), ReAct Tool-Use Loops, and Memory-Augmented Interaction, as implemented in buddyMe, an open-source multi-model agent programming framework. We formalize a five-stage processing pipeline: Requirement Pre-Review -> Task Decomposition -> ReAct Execution -> Real-Execution Verification -> Adversarial Evaluation Discussion, and establish a six-dimensional evaluation schema with weighted scoring. Through four empirical case studies drawn from real-world deployment logs covering museum guide generation, scheduled weather tasks, and comprehensive tour planning, we draw three key conclusions. First, Generator-Evaluator pre-review detects requirement omissions in 20 percent of complex tasks, with 80 percent tasks passing initial inspection. Second, the ReAct loop ensures stable subtask execution but leads to around 30 percent redundant tool invocations. Third, adversarial Evaluator-Defender discussions reach consensus within 2-3 rounds for nearly 70 percent of scenarios, functioning mainly for content refinement rather than logical reversal. We additionally provide three Mermaid-based architectural diagrams and conduct cross-paradigm comparisons with CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph, MemGPT and A-Mem across six system dimensions. The research outcomes offer practical design guidelines for constructing stable and reliable multi-paradigm agent systems.

</details>


### [399] [Voices in the Loop: Mapping Participatory AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16827)
*Rashid Mushkani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个参与式AI倡议的开放存储库与交互式地图集，基于可重复协议对全球倡议进行发现、审核、协调和发布。分析显示这些倡议在地理分布上高度集中，参与主要发生在问题定义、评估和治理阶段，而非模型开发或训练。该地图集通过版本化发布、记录链接、模式反馈和披露控制机制，支持比较研究、政策学习和社区监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参与式AI方法在公共、公民和人道主义领域日益增多，但关于参与如何组织的证据仍然碎片化，缺乏系统性的整理和比较框架。

Method: 基于Magana和Shilton的Trustworthy AI语料库协调记录，结合研究与实践中的额外审计案例，构建开放存储库和交互式地图集。开发了可重复的协议，涵盖发现、审核、协调、地理编码、溯源追踪和基于版本的发布流程。

Result: 记录了语料层面的模式：倡议集中在少数国家；参与最常见于问题定义、评估和治理阶段，而非模型开发或训练阶段。地图集通过版本化发布、记录链接的问题与注释渠道、模式反馈工作流以及编辑或限制披露请求，实现了参与式AI基础设施的设计与治理框架。

Conclusion: 该地图集作为一个可更新、可争议、可复用的动态清单，旨在支持比较研究、政策学习和社区监督，为参与式AI实践的系统化积累和治理提供了基础工具。

Abstract: Participatory approaches to artificial intelligence are increasingly documented across public, civic, and humanitarian settings, but evidence about how participation is organized remains fragmented. This paper reports on the construction of an open repository and interactive atlas of participatory AI initiatives, using records harmonized from Maga~na and Shilton's Trustworthy AI corpus, and additional audited cases from research and practice. We contribute three elements. First, we specify a reproducible protocol for discovery, vetting, harmonization, geocoding, provenance tracking, and release-based publication of participatory AI records. Second, we report corpus-level patterns in geography, participation tiers, lifecycle loci, organizational form, verification status, and remaining documentation gaps. Documented initiatives remain concentrated in a small number of countries, while participation is most often coded at problem formulation, evaluation, and governance rather than model development or training. Third, we show how the atlas operationalizes a design and governance framework for participatory-by-default AI infrastructures through versioned releases, record-linked issue and annotation channels, schema feedback workflows, and redaction or restricted-disclosure requests. The atlas is intended to support comparative research, policy learning, and community scrutiny through a living inventory that can be updated, contested, and reused.

</details>


### [400] [Sketch Then Paint: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Multi-Modal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16842)
*Siqi Luo,Jianghan Shen,Yi Xin,Huayu Zheng,Haoxing Chen,Yan Tai,Yue Li,Junjun He,Yihao Liu,Guangtao Zhai,Yuewen Cao,Xiaohong Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出HT-GRPO方法，通过分层TokenGRPO和Sketch-Then-Paint三阶段训练机制，结合分层信用分配，解决扩散多模态大语言模型在强化学习优化中因去噪序列多样性和忽略层级生成过程导致的奖励分配不准确问题，在GenEval和DPG基准上取得显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散多模态大语言模型在图像生成中表现优异，但通过强化学习优化面临两大挑战：一是单张图像可通过多种去噪序列生成，导致重要性比计算困难；二是现有方法忽略dMLLMs的层级生成过程（早期token定义全局布局，后期token关注局部细节），对所有token分配均匀奖励，无法反映各token对最终图像的实际贡献。

Method: 提出HT-GRPO方法，包含三个核心组件：1) Sketch-Then-Paint三阶段训练方案（全局→结构→细化）；2) 基于提示条件的估计器，从完全掩码状态计算重要性比；3) 分层信用分配机制，优先考虑关键结构token以确保准确的奖励传播。

Result: 在MMaDA和Lumina-DiMOO两个主流dMLLM骨干上，HT-GRPO在GenEval和DPG基准测试中取得显著提升，并在六项额外评估指标中证明在图像质量、美学评分和人类偏好方面均有改进。

Conclusion: HT-GRPO通过将层级生成过程显式集成到策略优化中，有效解决了dMLLM强化学习优化的关键难题，验证了分层奖励分配对提升图像生成质量的必要性。

Abstract: Diffusion Multi-Modal Large Language Models (dMLLMs) are powerful for image generation, but optimizing them through reinforcement learning (RL) remains a major challenge. One primary difficulty is that a single image can be generated through many different unmasking sequences, which makes calculating importance ratios often intractable. Additionally, existing methods tend to ignore the hierarchical generation process of dMLLMs, where early tokens define the global layout and later tokens focus on local details. By assigning uniform rewards to all tokens, these current methods fail to reflect the actual contribution of each token to the final image. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Token GRPO (HT-GRPO), which integrates this hierarchy directly into the policy optimization process. Our approach features a Sketch-Then-Paint training scheme that organizes updates into three distinct stages: global, structure, and refinement. We also use a prompt-conditioned estimator to calculate importance ratios starting from a fully masked state. Furthermore, we introduce a Hierarchical Credit Assignment mechanism that prioritizes key structural tokens to ensure accurate reward propagation. Experiments using two popular dMLLM backbones, MMaDA and Lumina-DiMOO, demonstrate that HT-GRPO achieves substantial gains on the GenEval and DPG benchmarks. Evaluations across six additional metrics confirm significant improvements in image quality, aesthetics, and human preference.

</details>


### [401] [Artificial Adaptive Intelligence: The Missing Stage Between Narrow and General Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16844)
*Boris Kriuk*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出并定义了"人工自适应智能(AAI)"这一新概念，指代无需人工设定超参数、能在多任务上保持竞争性能的机器学习系统，并建立了包括适应性指数、参数最小性原则等定量分析框架，通过多个跨领域案例论证AAI是从狭义人工智能通往通用人工智能的必经阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI领域存在一个未被命名的中间地带——介于狭义部署系统与通用智能之间，众多研究方向（元学习、神经架构搜索、AutoML、持续学习、进化计算、物理信息建模）虽在实践上趋于一致（减少人工参数设定），但缺乏统一的概念框架和命名，导致难以衡量进展、比较方法、明确目标。

Method: 1) 提出"人工自适应智能(AAI)"的操作性定义；2) 引入定量"适应性指数"，结合超参数吸收比例和性能比率两个维度；3) 建立"参数最小性原则"，基于最小描述长度(MDL)框架给出理论依据；4) 将现有方法归纳为三条路径：数据/任务感知配置、结构/进化变形、训练中自适应；5) 通过航空航天设计、金融机制检测、湍流建模、生态动力学、视觉-语言系统等案例验证。

Result: 揭示了元学习、神经架构搜索、AutoML、持续学习、进化计算、物理信息建模等方向在"去除人工参数设定"这一原则上的收敛性；建立了可量化的AAI评估框架；通过跨领域案例展示了AAI原则的适用性和有效性。

Conclusion: 从狭义人工智能(ANI)到通用人工智能(AGI)的路径必须经过人工自适应智能(AAI)这一阶段；明确命名这一阶段将改变我们衡量什么、构建什么以及如何定义成功。

Abstract: Between the narrow systems we deploy and the general intelligence we speculate about lies an entire regime of machine behavior that has never received its own name. This monograph argues that this regime is not empty: it is where meta-learning, neural architecture search, AutoML, continual learning, evolutionary computation, and physics-informed modeling have quietly converged on a common principle, namely the steady removal of the human from the loop of parameter specification. We name this regime Artificial Adaptive Intelligence (AAI) and define it operationally: a system exhibits AAI to the extent that it requires no human-specified tunable hyperparameters while maintaining competitive performance across a diverse distribution of tasks. To make the definition quantitative, we introduce an adaptivity index that measures progress along an axis orthogonal to scale, combining the fraction of hyperparameters absorbed by the system with the performance ratio against a task-specialized baseline. We develop the principle of parametric minimality and ground it in the minimum description length framework, showing that the appropriate hyperparameter count is data-determined rather than designer-determined. We then organize the field around three pathways to minimality: data- and task-aware configuration, structural and evolutionary morphing, and in-training self-adaptation. We analyze their stability, convergence, and governance implications, and illustrate them through case studies spanning aerospace design, financial regime detection, turbulence modeling, ecological dynamics, and vision-language systems. The thesis is that the path from ANI to AGI passes through AAI, and that naming this stage changes what we measure, what we build, and what we call a success.

</details>


### [402] [Learning to Learn from Multimodal Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16857)
*Xingyu Sui,Weixiang Zhao,Yongxin Tang,Yanyan Zhao,Yang Wu,Dandan Tu,Bing Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的自适应多模态经验学习范式，让智能体能够根据任务需求和交互历史动态构建、组织和利用记忆，将记忆设计从预定义组件转变为可学习过程，实验证明该方法能显著提升多模态任务的表现和泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有经验驱动学习方法主要在文本环境下开发，依赖手动设计的记忆模式，难以推广到多模态环境。实际场景中经验本质上是多模态的，最优的记忆结构高度依赖于具体任务且随时间演化，固定记忆设计无法满足需求。

Method: 提出"学会从多模态经验中学习"的新范式，将记忆设计从预定义组件转变为自适应的可学习过程，使智能体能够根据任务需求和交互历史动态构建、组织和利用记忆。

Result: 自适应记忆设计显著提升了智能体在多模态任务上的表现和泛化能力，验证了学习记忆机制在经验驱动学习中的关键作用。

Conclusion: 记忆设计不应是固定预设的，而应是自适应的学习过程；学习如何结构化经验对提升多模态任务性能至关重要。

Abstract: Experience-driven learning has emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling agents to improve from interaction trajectories by accumulating and reusing past experience. However, existing approaches are predominantly developed in textual settings and rely on manually designed memory schemas, limiting their applicability to multimodal environments. In real-world scenarios, experience is inherently multimodal, involving heterogeneous signals across perception, reasoning, and action, which makes effective memory design significantly more challenging. In particular, the optimal way to structure and utilize multimodal experience is highly task-dependent and evolves over time, rendering fixed memory designs insufficient. In this work, we propose a new paradigm, learning to learn from multimodal experience, which shifts memory design from a predefined component to an adaptive and learnable process. Our framework enables agents to dynamically construct, organize, and utilize memory based on task requirements and interaction history, effectively learning how to structure experience for improved performance. Experiments demonstrate that adaptive memory design substantially enhances agent performance and generalization across multimodal tasks, highlighting the critical role of learning memory mechanisms in experience-driven learning.

</details>


### [403] [Reasoning Can Be Restored by Correcting a Few Decision Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16874)
*Changshuo Shen,Leheng Sheng,Yuxin Chen,An Zhang,Xiang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文发现大型推理模型（LRM）相较于基础语言模型（Base LLM）的优势集中在少数早期规划决策token（约8%），并提出了一种仅在高度分歧位置进行单token干预的推理时委派方案，能以极小代价恢复甚至超越完整推理模型的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型在逐步生成过程中究竟在哪些地方出错，以及如何高效缩小基础模型与推理模型之间的性能差距，目前尚不清楚。

Method: 通过基于似然度的散度量化基础模型与推理模型在token级别的分布差异，发现分歧集中在早期规划token；提出分歧引导的token干预，仅在高度分歧位置由推理模型接管单个token，其余仍由基础模型生成。

Result: 在Qwen3-0.6B上，仅约8%的token存在显著分歧，这些token集中在响应早期，规划相关决策富集17倍，且与基础模型的高不确定性一致。稀疏干预方案能以极小预算恢复甚至超越完整推理模型的推理性能。

Conclusion: 基础模型的主要失败点在于早期规划决策token，通过针对这些关键位置的稀疏干预可以高效缩小基础-推理模型差距。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) substantially outperform their base LLM counterparts on challenging reasoning benchmarks, yet it remains poorly understood where base models go wrong during token-by-token generation and how to narrow this gap efficiently. We study the base-reasoning gap through quantifying token-level distributional disagreement between a base model and a stronger reasoning model using likelihood-based divergences. Across benchmarks, we find that the reasoning advantage is highly sparse and concentrates on a small set of early, planning-related decision tokens. For instance, on Qwen3-0.6B, only ~8% of generated tokens account for the salient disagreement, and these tokens concentrate early in the response, are strongly enriched in planning-related decisions (17x), and coincide with high base-model uncertainty -- suggesting that base models fail mainly at early planning points that steer the subsequent reasoning trajectory. Building on these findings, we propose disagreement-guided token intervention, a simple inference-time delegation scheme that performs a one-token takeover by the reasoning model only at high-disagreement positions and immediately switches back to the base model. With a small intervention budget, this sparse delegation substantially recovers and can even surpass the performance of a same-size reasoning model on challenging reasoning tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/AlphaLab-USTC/RRTokenIntervention.

</details>


### [404] [NGM: A Plug-and-Play Training-Free Memory Module for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16893)
*Yuwen Qu,Wenhui Dong,Chenyang Si,Caifeng Shan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出N-gram Memory (NGM)，一种无需训练、即插即用的记忆模块，通过因果N-gram编码器和余弦门控注入器，在不额外训练的情况下提升大模型性能，在代码生成和知识密集型任务上表现显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有条件记忆模块虽然比MoE更高效，但仍依赖学习得到的记忆嵌入，需要额外训练且灵活性受限。作者希望设计一种无需训练、可直接插拔的记忆增强方法。

Method: NGM由两个组件构成：(1) 因果N-gram编码器，直接对预训练token嵌入取平均构建N-gram表示，无需单独训练；(2) 余弦门控注入器，使用带ReLU的非参数化余弦门控将检索到的嵌入调制到上下文表示中。

Result: 在Qwen3系列（0.6B~14B）的8个基准上，NGM提升平均性能0.5~1.2个点，其中Qwen3-14B在LiveCodeBench上+3.0，GPQA上+3.03；在多模态基准MMStar上Qwen3-VL-2B提升+1.53。

Conclusion: NGM作为一种训练免费、即插即用的记忆模块，能有效提升大模型在代码生成和知识密集型任务上的表现，且无需额外训练或检索管线。

Abstract: Recent studies introduce conditional memory modules that decouple knowledge storage from neural computation, enabling more direct knowledge access. Compared to MoE, which relies on dynamic computation paths, explicit lookup provides a more efficient knowledge retrieval mechanism. However, these approaches still depend on learned memory embeddings, requiring additional training and limiting flexibility. To address this, we propose N-gram Memory (NGM), a training-free, plug-and-play module composed of a Causal N-Gram Encoder and a Cosine-Gated Memory Injector. The Causal N-Gram Encoder directly averages the pretrained token embeddings of the backbone model to construct N-gram representations, thereby eliminating the need to train separate N-gram embeddings from scratch. This design requires neither an additional memory table nor a retrieval pipeline. The Cosine-Gated Memory Injector then uses a non-parametric cosine gate with ReLU to modulate the retrieved embeddings into the contextual representations. We evaluate NGM on the Qwen3 series from 0.6B to 14B across eight benchmarks. NGM improves average performance by 0.5 to 1.2 points, with particularly clear gains on code generation and knowledge-intensive tasks (e.g., +3.0 on LiveCodeBench and +3.03 on GPQA for Qwen3-14B). Moreover, NGM also improves performance in multimodal benchmarks (e.g., MMStar +1.53 on Qwen3-VL-2B).

</details>


### [405] [From Static Risk to Dynamic Trajectories: Toward World-Model-Inspired Clinical Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16927)
*Pujun Feng,Xiaoyu Guo,Seyed Ehsan Saffari,Min Hun Lee,Siew-Kei Lam,Erik Cambria,Xibin Sun,Yangtao Zhou,Tong Yang,Xiaoyu Zhang,Tao Tan,Yue Sun,Bin Cui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个统一框架，将临床决策中的事实预测、反事实轨迹估计和政策评估三个任务，与疾病演化、治疗分配和观测过程三种数据生成机制相结合，系统解决了治疗混杂反馈、不规则观测等临床预测中的核心挑战，推动从静态基准预测向决策级临床证据的转化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态预测模型在临床应用中常失效，主要因为：(1) 模型在观测性医疗数据上训练时混淆了疾病生物学机制与临床医生行为；(2) 存在治疗-混杂反馈循环（治疗影响疾病轨迹，同时疾病状态影响治疗分配）；(3) 观测时间不规则且具有信息性（观测本身受病情严重程度影响）。现有方法缺乏统一的理论框架来应对这些挑战。

Method: 围绕六个相互关联的组件构建框架：三个决策任务（事实预测、反徒估计、政策评估）和三种数据生成机制（疾病演化、治疗分配、观测过程），后三者决定模型的可识别性。方法族包括：多状态/联合模型、时序点过程、深度序列架构、纵向因果推断。评估通过重叠诊断、不确定性量化、离线策略鲁棒性和目标试验验证来实现。

Result: 首次在离散/连续时间统一框架下桥接预测、反事实轨迹和政策评估，明确处理了治疗分配、时变混杂和观测偏差，并提出了与证据强度层级相对应的评估对齐方案。

Conclusion: 该框架将预测从基准评测提升为决策级临床证据，实现了治疗敏感的个体化疾病轨迹预测、部署前策略压力测试，以及更安全的闭环学习型医疗系统（在证据不足时自适应弃权）。

Abstract: Clinical decision-making is a feedback system where risk estimates influence treatment, which in turn changes disease trajectories, and both shape clinicians' measurement practices. Static prediction often fails clinically: models trained on observational care logs conflate disease biology with clinician behavior, particularly under treatment confounder feedback and irregular or informative observation. This Review focuses on intervention-aware disease trajectory modeling in clinical AI--methods estimating patient-specific longitudinal disease evolution and assessing trajectory changes under alternative treatments. We organize the field around six linked components: three decision tasks (factual forecasting, counterfactual estimation, policy evaluation) and three data-generating mechanisms (disease evolution, treatment assignment, observation process) that determine identifiability. We present the first unified framework bridging forecasting, counterfactual trajectories, and policy evaluation across discrete/continuous time, explicitly addressing treatment assignment, time-varying confounding, and observation bias. We synthesize key method families (multistate/joint models, temporal point-process, deep sequence architectures, longitudinal causal inference), map them to relevant components, and align evaluation with claim strength via overlap diagnostics, uncertainty quantification, off-policy robustness, and target-trial validation. This synthesis advances benchmark prediction to decision-grade clinical evidence, enabling treatment-sensitive individualized futures, pre-deployment policy stress-testing, and safer closed-loop learning health systems that adapt/abstain when evidence is insufficient.

</details>


### [406] [How do Humans Process AI-generated Hallucination Contents: a Neuroimaging Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16953)
*Shuqi Zhu,Yi Zhong,Ziyi Ye,Bangde Du,Yujia Zhou,Qingyao Ai,Yiqun Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过记录27名参与者在验证多模态大语言模型生成的图像描述正确性任务中的EEG信号，揭示了人脑在处理幻觉内容与非幻觉内容时表现出不同的神经动态模式，并且被误判的幻觉内容未能触发正常的神经认知事实验证通路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然AI生成的幻觉（hallucination）带来了相当大的风险，但人类能够成功识别或被这些幻觉误导的潜在认知机制尚不清楚。本文旨在探索人类的神经动态，以表征大脑如何处理幻觉内容。

Method: 记录27名参与者在执行验证任务（判断多模态大语言模型生成的图像描述是否正确）时的EEG信号，基于平均事件相关电位（ERP）进行研究分析。

Result: 多种认知过程（如语义整合、推理处理、记忆检索和认知负荷）在处理幻觉与非幻觉内容时表现出不同的模式。被误判与被正确判断的AI生成幻觉在神经响应上存在显著差异。

Conclusion: 被误判的AI生成幻觉未能触发标准的神经认知事实验证通路，这解释了人类为何会被AI幻觉内容所误导。

Abstract: While AI-generated hallucinations pose considerable risks, the underlying cognitive mechanisms by which humans can successfully recognize or be misled by these hallucinations remain unclear. To address this problem, this paper explores humans' neural dynamics to characterize how the brain processes hallucinated content. We record EEG signals from 27 participants while they are performing a verification task to judge the correctness of image descriptions generated by a multi-modal large language model (MLLM). Based on an averaged event-related potential (ERP) study, we reveal that multiple cognitive processes, e.g., semantic integration, inferential processing, memory retrieval, and cognitive load, exhibit distinct patterns when humans process hallucinated versus non-hallucinated content. Notably, neural responses to hallucinations that were misjudged versus correctly judged by human participants showed significant differences. This indicates that misjudged AI-generated hallucinations failed to trigger the standard neurocognitive fact verification pathway.

</details>


### [407] [Harnessing AI for Inverse Partial Differential Equation Problems: Past, Present, and Prospects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16966)
*Zhentao Tan,Yuze Hao,Boyi Zou,Mingsheng Long,Yi Yang,Gang Bao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文全面综述了人工智能在求解偏微分方程反问题中的最新进展，将反PDE问题系统划分为反问题、逆设计与控制问题三大类别，并总结了各范畴的方法范式、代表性应用及未来挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反PDE问题在医学成像、地球物理、材料科学和空气动力学等领域具有广泛应用，传统数值方法面临高维、非线性、不适定等挑战，亟需借助AI方法实现突破。

Method: 论文首先阐述反PDE问题的基本形式与关键难点，将其系统性地分为三类（反问题、逆设计、控制问题）；针对每一类归纳方法范式，并综述近年代表性前沿方法；最后总结跨领域应用并讨论开放挑战。

Result: 形成了首个统一且系统化的AI求解反PDE问题视角，涵盖机械系统、气动问题、热系统、全波形反演、系统辨识和医学成像等典型应用场景。

Conclusion: 现代基于学习的方法正在重塑PDE控制系统中反问题、逆设计与控制问题的求解方式，未来方向包括物理信息架构、真实数据稀缺、不确定性量化及反问题基础模型等。

Abstract: Solving inverse partial differential equation (PDE) problems is a fundamental topic in scientific research due to its broad significance across a wide range of real-world applications. Inverse PDE problems arise across medical imaging, geophysics, materials science, and aerodynamics, where the goal is to infer hidden causes, design structures, or control physical states. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive review of recent advances in solving inverse PDE problems using artificial intelligence (AI). We first introduce the basic formulation, key challenges, and traditional numerical foundations of inverse PDE problems, and then organize it into three major categories: inverse problems, inverse design, and control problems. For each category, we further present a methodological paradigms, and review representative state-of-the-art approaches from recent years. We then summarize representative applications across scientific and industrial domains, including mechanical systems, aerodynamic problems, thermal systems, full-waveform inversion, system identification, and medical imaging. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future prospects, such as physics-informed architectures, limited real-world data, uncertainty quantification, and inverse foundation models. This survey aims to provide the first unified and systematic perspective on AI for inverse PDE problems, demonstrating how modern learning-based methods are reshaping inverse problems, inverse design, and control problems in PDE-governed systems.

</details>


### [408] [Brain Vascular Age Prediction Using Cerebral Blood Flow Velocity and Machine Learning Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16969)
*Anni Zhao,Alex Bateh,Tyler Baldridge,Sandra Billinger,Xiao Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究利用经颅多普勒超声（TCD）提取特征，通过机器学习回归模型预测脑血管年龄，并评估不同脑疾病患者的加速衰老程度。健康被试平均预测年龄比实际年龄高3.69岁，不同疾病组表现出不同程度的年龄加速，表明TCD特征可用于评估脑血管加速衰老，同时发现不平衡数据集会影响模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以生理功能定义血管年龄已成为分类和追踪实际年龄的重要研究方向，本研究旨在利用TCD特征估算实际年龄，并评估多种脑疾病患者的加速衰老程度。

Method: 使用MOCAIP算法分析168名健康被试和277名疾病患者的双侧大脑中动脉TCD记录，提取MOCAIP特征和心率变异性特征作为输入，训练回归模型预测脑血管年龄。测试对象包括急性卒中（66人）、卒中后（27人）、阿尔茨海默病（26人）、轻度认知障碍（23人）及已确诊患者（135人）。

Result: 健康被试的脑血管预测年龄平均比实际年龄高3.69岁；不同疾病组表现出不同程度的年龄加速；TCD特征可有效区分健康与疾病状态；不平衡数据集会影响脑年龄预测模型的性能。

Conclusion: TCD生成的特征在评估脑血管加速衰老方面具有相关性，但数据不平衡问题需在机器学习模型训练中加以关注。

Abstract: Defining vascular age in terms of physiological function has become one focal point of the extensive studies to categorize and track chronological age. Transcranial Doppler (TCD) is a method by which cerebral blood flow velocity is measured along the major arteries feeding the human brain. This study aims to use features extracted from TCD to estimate chronological age and assess accelerated aging in subjects with various brain diseases. We predict subjects with various brain diseases to present with accelerated cerebrovascular aging when tested on various regression models trained by healthy subjects. 168 healthy subjects and 277 diseased subjects with bilateral TCD recordings of the middle cerebral artery were analyzed using the Morphological Analysis and Clustering of Intracranial Pressure (MOCAIP) algorithm. MOCAIP-generated features and heart rate variability features were used as input features for regression models to predict the brain vascular age. 66 subjects with acute stroke, 27 subjects with post stroke, 26 subjects with Alzheimer's disease, 23 subjects with mild cognitive impairment, and 135 established subjects were tested against the machine learning model to assess for accelerated cerebrovascular age. The trained model, on average, predicted healthy subjects' cerebrovascular age to be 3.69 years above their chronological age. Subjects with different disease conditions exhibited varying levels of age acceleration. The differences in healthy and diseased subjects' performances suggest that features generated using TCD may be relevant when evaluating accelerated cerebrovascular aging. Moreover, imbalanced datasets have been observed to affect the performance of machine-learning-based brain age prediction models.

</details>


### [409] [A Conflict-aware Evidential Framework for Reliable Sleep Stage Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17021)
*Yunzhi Tian,Dekui Wang,Qirong Bu,Wei Zhou,Xingxing Hao,Jun Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ConfSleepNet，一种冲突感知的置信框架，通过多视图证据提取和冲突感知聚合动态解决多模态睡眠数据中的视图冲突，提升睡眠分期可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有睡眠分期多视图学习方法假设不同模态数据是良好对齐的，但在实际场景中难以满足，这损害了分期结果的可靠性。因此需要一种能够动态解决视图间冲突的框架。

Method: 提出ConfSleepNet框架，包含两个阶段：(1) 多视图证据提取阶段，从不同模态学习类别相关证据，并针对不同模态特性设计混合类别结构以促进合理证据学习；(2) 冲突感知聚合阶段，从证据构建视图特定的意见（预测结果和不确定性），通过新颖的冲突感知聚合方法整合这些意见为可靠的联合决策。

Result: 理论分析和实验结果均证明了ConfSleepNet在睡眠分期任务中的有效性。

Conclusion: ConfSleepNet能够有效解决多模态睡眠数据中的视图间冲突，生成可靠的分期决策，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multi-view learning has been widely applied for sleep stage classification using multi-modal data. However, existing methods typically assume that different modalities are well-aligned, which is often unattainable in real-world scenarios, thereby compromising the reliability of the staging results. In this paper, we propose ConfSleepNet, a conflict-aware evidential framework that dynamically resolves inter-view conflicts. The framework consists of multi-view evidence extraction and conflict-aware aggregation. In the first phase, it learns category-related evidence from different modalities, which represents the degree of support for individual sleep stages. Considering the inherent characteristics of varying modalities, we propose hybrid category structures for different modalities to promote more reasonable evidence learning. In the second phase, view-specific opinions, including prediction results and uncertainty, are constructed from the learned evidence. Notably, we propose a novel conflict-aware aggregation method that integrates these view-specific opinions into a reliable joint decision. This mechanism can effectively resolve conflicts among opinions and synthesize them into a reliable joint decision. Both theoretical analysis and experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of ConfSleepNet in sleep staging tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/By4te/ConfSleepNet_ICML2026/.

</details>


### [410] [Reliability and Effectiveness of Autonomous AI Agents in Supply Chain Management](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17036)
*Carol Xuan Long,David Simchi-Levi,Feng Zhu,Huangyuan Su,Andre P. Calmon,Flavio P. Calmon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在MIT啤酒游戏的多级供应链环境中研究自主生成式AI智能体，识别出模型选择、策略与护栏、集中数据共享和提示工程四个推理时杠杆。模型能力是主导因素：开箱即用的推理模型超越人类水平，优化后成本降低67%。但引入"智能体牛鞭效应"——决策不可靠性在供应链各层级间放大，表现为跨设施和跨时间的决策方差增加。提出基于GRPO的强化学习后训练框架，用系统级供应链奖励训练共享基础LLM，有效减少尾部事件、遏制智能体牛鞭效应并提升可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究自主生成式AI智能体在复杂多级供应链中的表现，特别是其可靠性问题，因为平均性能优异但可能掩盖重大的可靠性风险，需要系统性地理解和解决这一问题。

Method: 在MIT啤酒游戏平台上，通过四个推理时杠杆（模型选择、策略与护栏、集中数据共享、提示工程）系统评估AI智能体性能，引入"智能体牛鞭效应"的数学框架描述决策不可靠性放大机制，并提出基于GRPO的强化学习后训练框架，使用系统级供应链奖励训练共享基础LLM。

Result: 推理模型超越人类水平，优化后成本降低67%；发现了智能体牛鞭效应（决策方差在跨设施和跨时间两个维度放大）；证明重复采样无法有效缓解该问题；GRPO后训练显著减少尾部事件、遏制智能体牛鞭效应并提升可靠性。

Conclusion: 自主AI智能体在供应链中有巨大潜力，但需重视可靠性问题；GRPO后训练框架是通过系统级多智能体强化学习提升自主供应链智能体可靠性的有效方法。

Abstract: This paper studies autonomous generative AI agents in multi-echelon supply chains using the MIT Beer Game. We identify four inference-time levers that shape performance: model selection, policies and guardrails, centralized data sharing, and prompt engineering. Model capability is the dominant factor: an out-of-the-box reasoning model exceeds human-level performance, and optimized reasoning models reduce costs by up to 67% relative to human teams. However, strong average performance masks substantial reliability risks. We introduce the agent bullwhip effect, the amplification of decision unreliability across echelons, manifesting along two dimensions: decision variance increases both across facilities at the same point in time and within the same facility across time. We develop a mathematical framework showing that this phenomenon is inherent to multi-agent systems that involve coordination and information delays, and we demonstrate that repeated sampling fails to meaningfully reduce it. To address this limitation, we propose a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)-based reinforcement-learning post-training framework that trains a shared base LLM using system-level supply-chain rewards. GRPO post-training substantially reduces tail events, curtails agent bullwhip, and improves the reliability of autonomous supply-chain agents.

</details>


### [411] [PersonaArena: Dynamic Simulation for Evaluating and Enhancing Persona-Level Role-Playing in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17044)
*Wenlong Shi,Jianxun Lian,Mingqi Wu,Haiming Qin,Mingyang Zhou,Xing Xie,Naipeng Chao,Hao Liao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PersonaArena，一个用于评估和提升大语言模型人格层面角色扮演能力的动态模拟框架，包含细粒度人格库、多轮社交模拟环境和多智能体辩论裁判机制，实验证明其能有效评估和增强模型的社会交互真实性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM角色扮演研究主要集中在角色（character）层面，采用静态评估格式，无法捕捉日常社交互动的复杂性，需要更真实的动态评估框架来评估和提升模型在人设（persona）层面的角色扮演能力。

Method: 基于大规模用户生成社交内容构建细粒度人格库；设计多轮上下文丰富的社交模拟环境；提出多智能体辩论裁判机制以实现全面公正的评估。

Result: 通过大量实验证明PersonaArena能够对LLM的角色扮演能力进行严格评估，并有效提升模型的社会交互真实性和社交胜任力。

Conclusion: PersonaArena为开发更真实、更具社交能力的AI智能体提供了有效的评估与改进框架，推动了LLM在人格层面角色扮演能力的发展。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as interactive social agents, yet their ability to maintain coherent and authentic persona-level role-playing remains limited, particularly in realistic social scenarios. Existing research predominantly focuses on character-level settings and relies on static evaluation formats, failing to capture the complexity of everyday social interactions. In this work, we present PersonaArena, a dynamic simulation framework for evaluating and improving persona-level role-playing in LLMs. PersonaArena leverages a large, filtered corpus of user-generated social content to construct a nuanced persona bank, and elicits multi-turn, context-rich interactions within simulated social environments. Our framework features a multi-agent debating judge for holistic and unbiased assessment. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that PersonaArena enables rigorous evaluation and enhancement of LLMs' role-playing capabilities, advancing the development of more authentic and socially adept AI agents.

</details>


### [412] [Towards Human-Level Book-Writing Capability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17064)
*Jan Zierstek,Matteo Batelic,Maya Medjad,Tim Schönenberger*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向书籍级创意写作的数据构建与训练框架，通过将公开领域小说按多层次（前提→章节→场景）逐步摘要构建规划支架，并在训练中反转这一层级结构（从提示逐步扩展到完整书籍文本），使长上下文语言模型从"助手式散文"转向更具人类文学性的写作风格。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型虽在指令跟随和智能体任务上表现优异，但在高质量创意写作方面存在严重不足：它们倾向于避免欺骗、道德模糊和不可靠叙述等人类文学中常见的手法，导致生成的故事结构正确但风格千篇一律、过于解释性、缺乏文学根基。

Method: 1) 数据构建：从公开领域小说出发，逐层生成从高级前提到章节结构再到场景细节的多分辨率规划支架；2) 训练框架：反转这一层级结构，将监督微调重构为"提示→书籍"的生成任务，模型先学习将提示扩展为逐步细化的计划，最终生成原始人类作者的小说文本；3) 训练中间摘要作为中间目标，最终以人类散文为监督信号。

Result: 训练后的长上下文语言模型在生成风格上从助手式散文向人类文学写作偏移，减轻了结构正确但风格单调的问题。

Conclusion: 通过将人类小说重构为分层次、可学习的"提示→书籍"轨迹，可以有效引导模型摆脱助手式写作模式，生成更具人类文学性的长文本。

Abstract: Large language models optimized for instruction following and agentic tasks remain poorly aligned with the requirements of high-quality creative writing. Fiction frequently depends on behaviors that assistant-tuned models are explicitly trained to avoid, particularly deception, moral ambiguity, and unreliable narration. As a result, generated stories often appear structurally correct while remaining stylistically generic, overly explanatory, or weakly grounded in human literary behavior. We present a dataset construction and training framework for book-scale creative writing that reframes supervised fine-tuning as a prompt-to-book generation task grounded in human-authored fiction. Starting from public-domain novels, we derive a multi-resolution planning scaffold by summarizing each book at progressively finer levels, from a high-level premise to chapter- and scene-level structure. We then invert this hierarchy during training: the model learns to expand a prompt into increasingly detailed plans and finally into the original human-authored book text. This formulation preserves human prose as the final supervised target while using intermediate summaries to make book-scale generation learnable. We train a long-context language model on these prompt-to-book trajectories and study whether this objective shifts generation away from assistant-style prose and toward human literary writing.

</details>


### [413] [AnchorDiff: Topology-Aware Masked Diffusion with Confidence-based Rewriting for Radiology Report Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17071)
*Shiying Yu,Jielei Wang,Guoming Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AnchorDiff 是首个用于放射学报告生成的掩码扩散框架，通过知识图谱衍生的临床锚点、拓扑感知训练和推理时重写策略，在 MIMIC-CXR 和 MIMIC-RG4 基准上达到了 SOTA 性能，有效克服了自回归模型的序列偏差问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于自回归语言模型的放射学报告生成方法存在因果依赖结构导致的序列偏差，模型倾向于遵循固定标记顺序和高频报告模板，而非充分基于图像特定证据进行生成。

Method: 1) 提出首个掩码扩散框架 AnchorDiff，将知识图谱（RadGraph）衍生的临床锚点集成到扩散语言建模中，利用双向上下文和迭代精炼进行生成。2) 拓扑感知训练策略：基于 RadGraph 实体层级为临床重要标记分配差异化的掩码保护和损失权重。3) 推理时重写策略：通过基于扰动的测试检测不稳定的已提交标记，在去噪过程中选择性修正。

Result: 在 MIMIC-CXR 和 MIMIC-RG4 两个基准数据集上达到 SOTA 性能，验证了临床锚定的掩码扩散方法在放射学报告生成中的有效性。

Conclusion: AnchorDiff 通过掩码扩散框架结合临床知识图谱锚点，有效克服了自回归模型的序列偏差问题，为放射学报告生成提供了一种新的范式。

Abstract: Radiology report generation (RRG) aims to automatically produce clinically accurate textual reports from medical images. Existing methods predominantly rely on autoregressive (AR) language models, whose causal dependency structure restricts generation to a unidirectional left-to-right process. This paradigm can induce sequence bias, where models tend to follow stereotypical token orders and high-frequency report templates rather than fully grounding generation in image-specific evidence. In this paper, we propose AnchorDiff, the first masked-diffusion framework for RRG that integrates knowledge-graph-derived clinical anchors into diffusion language modeling. By leveraging bidirectional context and iterative refinement, AnchorDiff mitigates the limitations of fixed-order autoregressive decoding. Specifically, we introduce a topology-aware training strategy that uses RadGraph-derived entity hierarchies to assign clinically important tokens differentiated masking protection and loss weights. We further design an inference-time rewriting strategy that detects unstable committed tokens through perturbation-based testing and selectively revises them during denoising. Extensive experiments on the MIMIC-CXR and MIMIC-RG4 benchmarks demonstrate that AnchorDiff achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance, showing the effectiveness of clinically anchored masked diffusion for radiology report generation.

</details>


### [414] [RAGA: Reading-And-Graph-building-Agent for Autonomous Knowledge Graph Construction and Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17072)
*Chengrui Han,Zesheng Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出RAGA框架，通过LLM驱动的自主知识图谱构建与检索融合，采用ReAct认知约束和KG-向量同步机制，在QASPER数据集上初步实验表明融合检索优于零样本基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的知识图谱构建方法采用无状态批处理流水线，在跨块语义关系捕捉、实体消歧和构建过程可解释性方面存在结构性缺陷，影响KG质量、检索精度和部署可信度。

Method: RAGA框架提供支持全生命周期CRUD操作的原子工具集，将Read-Search-Verify-Construct认知约束嵌入ReAct工具循环，设计KG-向量同步机制实现混合符号-向量检索，并通过证据锚定验证将知识条目链接到源文本以实现可审计溯源。

Result: 在QASPER科学QA数据集子集上的初步实验表明，RAGA的融合检索优于零样本基线，KG集成在答案质量和证据质量上均有可衡量的提升。

Conclusion: 该框架设计和实验基线为智能体驱动的自主KG构建提供了参考，验证了融合检索范式的有效性。

Abstract: Existing LLM-driven knowledge graph (KG) construction methods predominantly employ stateless batch processing pipelines, exhibiting structural deficiencies in cross-chunk semantic relation capture, entity disambiguation, and construction process interpretability. These limitations undermine KG quality, retrieval precision, and deployment trust in high-stakes domains.
  We propose RAGA (Reading And Graph-building Agent), an LLM-based autonomous KG construction and retrieval fusion framework. RAGA provides an atomic toolset supporting full KG lifecycle CRUD operations and embeds a Read-Search-Verify-Construct cognitive constraint into a ReAct tool loop. A KG-vector synchronization mechanism enables hybrid symbolic-vector retrieval, while evidence-anchored verification links every knowledge entry to its source text for auditable provenance.
  Preliminary experiments on a subset of the QASPER scientific QA dataset indicate that RAGA's fusion retrieval outperforms zero-shot baselines, with KG integration providing measurable gains in both answer and evidence quality. The framework design and experimental baseline serve as a reference for agent-driven autonomous KG construction.

</details>


### [415] [Scientific Logicality Enriched Methodology for LLM Reasoning: A Practice in Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17104)
*Zhaoxin Yu,Nan Xu,Kun Chen,Jiahao Zhao,Lei Wang,Wenji Mao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究大语言模型科学推理中的逻辑性，提出了一套包含评估标准和数据采样方法的科学逻辑性增强方法论，并以物理学为例构建高质量逻辑性数据集，实验证明该方法能有效提升LLM推理的逻辑忠实度和任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要通过更大规模数据集和更长推理链来提升LLM在科学问答基准上的表现，但忽视了科学推理过程的本质——逻辑性，即确保推理步骤有效性和结论可靠性的理性基础。

Method: 提出科学逻辑性增强方法论，包括：1）一套评估科学推理逻辑性的标准；2）用于逻辑性引导训练的数据采样方法；以物理学为示范学科，从学术文献中提取科学问题并采样高质量逻辑性数据集，基于三个不同骨干LLM进行实验验证。

Result: 1）构建的训练数据能有效提升LLM推理中的科学逻辑性；2）增强的科学逻辑性在解决科学问题中发挥关键作用。

Conclusion: 关注逻辑性这一科学推理的本质要素，能够提升LLM科学推理的逻辑忠实度和任务性能，为未来科学推理研究提供了新方向。

Abstract: With the continuous advancement of reasoning abilities in Large Language Models (LLMs), their application to scientific reasoning tasks has gained significant research attention. Current research primarily emphasizes boosting LLMs' performance on scientific QA benchmarks by training on larger, more comprehensive datasets with extended reasoning chains. However, these approaches neglect the essence of the scientific reasoning process -- logicality, which is the rational foundation to ensure the validity of reasoning steps leading to reliable conclusions. In this work, we make the first systematic investigation into the internal logicality underlying LLM scientific reasoning, and develop a scientific logicality-enriched methodology, including a set of assessment criteria and data sampling methods for logicality-guided training, to improve the logical faithfulness as well as task performance. Further, we take physics, characterized by its diverse logical structures and formalisms, as an exemplar discipline to practise the above methodology. For data construction, we extract scientific problems from academic literature and sample a high-quality dataset exhibiting strong logicality. Experiments based on three different backbone LLMs reveal that: 1) the training data we constructed can effectively improve the scientific logicality in LLM reasoning; and 2) the enriched scientific logicality plays a critical role in solving scientific problems. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/ScienceOne-AI/PhysLogic}{https://github.com/ScienceOne-AI/PhysLogic}.

</details>


### [416] [Capturing LLM Capabilities via Evidence-Calibrated Query Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17110)
*Fangzhou Wu,Sandeep Silwal,Qiuyi Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ECC算法，利用有限的后验模型比较校准先验语义嵌入，通过Bradley-Terry模型参数化的能力轮廓和可训练混合权重，实现能力感知的查询聚类，显著提升LLM能力排序质量（平均超越人类标注17.64%、嵌入方法18.02%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有查询聚类方法依赖语义分类或嵌入，无法捕获表面语义与真实模型性能之间的对齐偏差，导致难以反映潜在的能力需求差异。
